summary_1line: Rishis praise the merit of pilgrimage and recitation; Pulastya and Narada depart, and Yudhishthira explains sending Arjuna to obtain divine weapons.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Pulastya, radiant and serene, fades into the air before Bhishma after blessing his sacred pilgrimage.
Narada, veena in hand, vanishes into the sky after advising Yudhishthira among gathered ascetics.
Yudhishthira sits among forest ascetics describing how Arjuna has been sent to the heavens to obtain celestial weapons.
